Done — I refreshed the UI and split the frontend code into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Gave the app a more modern visual style:
  - softer glassy cards
  - updated color palette
  - improved spacing, shadows, and typography
  - a more polished dashboard hero area
  - nicer auth pages and buttons
- Split frontend JavaScript into smaller files:
  - `public/js/dom.js` for small DOM helpers
  - `public/js/tasks.js` for dashboard/task logic
  - `public/js/auth.js` for login/signup/logout behavior
- Simplified the main page HTML a bit and updated login/signup page copy/layout to match the new look.
- Tidied `src/app.js` by extracting the security header setup into a small helper.

Validation:
- Ran the test suite successfully: all tests passed.

If you want, I can also do a second pass to split the backend route files into even smaller service/controller modules while keeping behavior the same.
